nina-sales: Quick request from the vendor risk reviewer for our POC with AcmeCorp. They want a concise access-control evidence packet: SSO/SAML attribute map + metadata, confirmation MFA is enforced for privileged users (billing/org-admin), SCIM provisioning examples showing group-scoped and domain-filtered sync, RBAC samples that demonstrate least-privilege and separation-of-duties, and one sample of service-account key rotation/audit. Target: Mon EOD. Can we collect artifacts and an attestation? :clipboard:

sam-security: I can collate screenshots (Console > Integrations > SSO, Console > IAM > Roles), redact PII from logs, and draft the one-paragraph attestation. We use KMS/HSM for secrets at rest.

victor-ops: Service-account notes: infra tokens TTL=7d (default), app tokens TTL=30d. Rotation is automatic via key-rotator job (cron: `0 */4 * * *`) which updates secrets in Secret Manager and posts rotation events to the audit stream. I'll export a redacted slice showing create/rotate/delete events.

laura-se: SAML snippet we provide to IdP admins (YAML):

laura-se: ```yaml
entity_id: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
acs: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
name_id_format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
attributes:
  - name: email
    source: mail
  - name: roles
    source: http://schemas.redwood.com/claims/roles
  - name: groups
    source: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group
```

laura-se: We'll include the metadata URL, ACS endpoint, and the current signing-cert fingerprint so their SAML admin can validate. Note: for Azure AD customers we recommend validating the cert thumbprint in the portal.

laura-se: On SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 and allow scoping/provisioning to only mapped groups. We also support filtering (e.g., domain-based) at provisioning time. Example mapping: IdP group `eng-acme` -> Redwood role `model-deployer:execute`. You can map multiple IdP groups to one Redwood role or one group to many roles.

laura-se: SCIM PATCH example we commonly share for tests:

laura-se: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{groupId} -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-abc"}]}]}'
```

laura-se: And an example GET with a domain filter for delta provisioning/tests:

laura-se: ```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users?filter=emails.value%20co%20%22%40acme.com%22" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN"
```

sam-security: RBAC notes: we maintain a roles CSV (role_id, role_name, surfaces, sample_permissions). For this bundle we'll include trimmed rows for `org-admin`, `billing-admin`, `model-deployer`, `service-account`. Separation-of-duties: billing actions are gated to `billing-admin`; org-wide changes require `org-admin` + PR workflow (PR + two approvers: Security + Platform). I'll add a short matrix screenshot and the PR checklist snippet (redacted).

victor-ops: I'll drop the redacted audit slice and the key-rotator Cron config into the shared folder. Rotation events in the audit look like: `service_account_id, event=create|rotate|delete, actor=system, note=rotated-by-key-rotator`. I'll obfuscate exact timestamps but keep dates.

sam-security: Draft attestation to include: "Security has reviewed and confirms that the attached artifacts (SSO metadata, SCIM mappings and examples, MFA policy screenshots, RBAC export, and redacted audit logs) accurately reflect Redwood Inference access controls and provisioning behavior as of 2025-08-12. For verification, contact security@redwood.example.com." I'll sign and include contact info.

audit-bot: nightly audit export completed at 01:05 UTC (audit-export/2025-08-11-0105.csv).

nina-sales: Thanks all. Upload destination: https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-acme/evidence. Please drop final files by Mon 17:00 UTC and ping here once uploaded. I'll send to the reviewer's mailbox after upload. :white_check_mark:
